data.one_liner: Apply AI-powered adaptive inner and outer glow effects to Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: Applies adaptive inner and outer glow effects to widgets using on-device AI for dynamic styling and color generation. It offers customizable parameters like glow width, blur, and border radius with AI-driven defaults.
use_when: You want to add modern, AI-inspired glow effects to UI elements
You need dynamic inner or outer glow effects that adapt to widget content or environments
avoid_when: You require traditional non-animated static shadows without any custom glow wrappers
You need packages from the predefined alternatives catalog
strengths: Adaptive inner and contextual outer glow support
data.minimal_example:
OuterAiGlow(
  child: YourWidget(),
  height: 200,
  width: 200,
  borderRadius: 15,
  glowWidth: 3,
  blure: 8,
  colors: [Colors.cyan, Colors.indigo, Colors.teal],
  aiMode: AiMode.contextual,
)
